t: Islam, I put braces on my patients,
but treatment drags on for months.
They don't brush properly and forget their elastics.
And kids just don't want to brush.
Make it so a patient simply can't miss it.
Deal.
I'll build an app for kids and adults.
Here's what I built.
An alarm rings morning and evening.
Tap Start, and a character copies your face.
Open your mouth, it opens too.
A timer guides you through 6 zones.
Two minutes, no zone missed.
Braces or elastics?
Special modes remind you to brush and wear them.
Kids earn coins and buy rewards.
Brushing becomes a game.
Parents see on their phone if the child brushed.
Missed it? A notification comes, even if the phone is off.
That's exactly what I wanted.
Need an app for your business?
Comment “APP” and let's talk.
